scene_summary: The video shows a manufacturing floor with a large blue mechanical press on the left, where a worker is seated at the controls. A marked aisle runs through the center of the scene, containing a stationary circular metal object. Another worker walks along a designated green path on the right side of the frame.

findings.title: Obstruction in Marked Aisle
findings.location: Center of the marked aisle, Z07
findings.observation: A large circular metal object is resting on the floor directly across the yellow painted boundary line of the main aisle. The object remains stationary in sampled frames (E024, E025).
findings.risk_interpretation: The object encroaches upon a marked path for movement or material handling. While the specific clearance requirements depend on site verification and intended use, the visible encroachment presents a potential obstruction.
findings.applicability_reason: The object is located within a marked aisle; 1910.176(a) applies where mechanical handling equipment is used and requires safe clearances.
unknowns: Whether the path is designated for mechanical handling equipment
Intended clearance width for this specific aisle
Whether the object is an emergency exit route (exit status unknown)
recommended_actions: Verify if the object is required in this location.
Remove or relocate the object to a designated storage area outside of all walkways and operational zones using appropriate handling methods.

findings.title: Worker Proximity to Machine Point of Operation
findings.observation: A worker is seated at the controls of a mechanical press. The worker's hands are positioned near the machine interface, and their head is close to the machinery opening (E016, E034).
findings.risk_interpretation: The worker's position suggests potential interaction with the point of operation. It is unknown if the machine is in an active operating cycle or if the worker is performing maintenance.
findings.applicability_reason: The machine appears to be a mechanical power press, which requires specific safeguarding at the point of operation.
unknowns: Whether the worker is performing production or maintenance
Applicability of 1910.217 to this specific machine type
recommended_actions: Verify if the machine is active; if so, ensure the worker is using the required safeguarding device.
If maintenance is being performed, confirm that Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures are followed by qualified personnel.
